import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_59/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be listed here
    ]

    # Initialize an empty list to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file, select needed columns, and append to dfs
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Select only the columns needed for the target schema
        # Target schema: ['PRODUCTLINE': string, 'SALES': float]
        df_selected = df[['PRODUCTLINE', 'SALES']].copy()
        dfs.append(df_selected)

    # Concatenate all dataframes from sources
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Group by PRODUCTLINE and sum SALES to match target examples
    result_df = combined_df.groupby('PRODUCTLINE', as_index=False)['SALES'].sum()

    # Optional: sort by SALES descending to resemble target examples order
    result_df = result_df.sort_values(by='SALES', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_59/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    result_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
